q.hi: Aapne ab tak ka sabse impactful project kaun sa kiya hai aur uska impact kya tha?
q.en: What is the most impactful project you have worked on, and what was its impact?

checks.hi: Kya aap apne kaam ko business outcome se jod paate ho aur apna exact role bata paate ho.
checks.en: Whether you can tie your work to a business outcome and state your exact role.

hi: Problem aur kyon zaroori tha (user/business pain)
Aapka specific role aur ownership
Key technical kaam jo aapne khud kiya
Measurable result: latency, cost, revenue, ya users
Aaj peeche dekh ke kya seekha
en: The problem and why it mattered (user/business pain)
Your specific role and ownership
The key technical work you personally did
Measurable result: latency, cost, revenue or users
What you learned looking back

tip.hi: Ek hi project choose karo jisme aap deep dive ke liye ready ho; "we" nahi "I" bolo.
tip.en: Pick one project you can deep-dive on for 30 minutes; say "I", not "we".

q.hi: Apne kaam ka impact numbers mein bataiye, kaun se metrics improve hue?
q.en: Quantify the impact of your work: which metrics moved and by how much?

checks.hi: Kya aap data-driven ho aur kya aapko pata hai success kaise measure hua.
checks.en: Whether you are data-driven and know how success was actually measured.

hi: Baseline vs after numbers (e.g. p99 800ms se 200ms)
Metric kaise measure kiya: dashboard, A/B test, logs
Business translation: cost saved, conversion, tickets kam
Kitna credit aapka, kitna team ka, honestly
en: Baseline vs after numbers (e.g. p99 from 800ms to 200ms)
How it was measured: dashboard, A/B test, logs
Business translation: cost saved, conversion, fewer tickets
Honest split of credit between you and the team

tip.hi: Approx numbers bhi chalenge, par unka source batao; bina numbers ke answer weak lagta hai.
tip.en: Approximate numbers are fine if you name the source; no numbers reads as no impact.

q.hi: Aisa koi kaam bataiye jo aapne bina kisi ke kahe kiya aur jisse team ya product ko fayda hua.
q.en: Tell me about something you did without being asked that benefited the team or product.

checks.hi: Initiative aur bias for action: kya aap khud problems dhoondte ho.
checks.en: Initiative and bias for action: do you find problems on your own.

hi: Problem kaise notice kiya (on-call pain, metrics, toil)
Stakeholders ko kaise convince kiya ya time nikala
Kya build/fix kiya
Result aur adoption
en: How you noticed the problem (on-call pain, metrics, toil)
How you got buy-in or carved out time
What you built or fixed
Result and adoption

tip.hi: Tooling, automation, ya observability ke examples yahan strong hote hain.
tip.en: Tooling, automation or observability wins make strong examples here.

q.hi: Aapne kabhi system ki performance, cost ya reliability kaise improve ki?
q.en: Describe a time you improved performance, cost or reliability of a system.

checks.hi: Engineering depth aur kya aap bottleneck ko data se identify karte ho.
checks.en: Engineering depth and whether you find bottlenecks with data, not guesses.

hi: Symptom aur kaise profile/measure kiya
Root cause (N+1 query, missing index, GC, lock contention)
Fix aur considered alternatives
Before/after numbers aur regression kaise roka
en: The symptom and how you profiled or measured it
Root cause (N+1 query, missing index, GC, lock contention)
The fix and alternatives considered
Before/after numbers and how you prevented regression

tip.hi: Pehle measure, phir optimize; interviewer "kaise pata chala?" zaroor poochega.
tip.en: Measure first, then optimize; expect "how did you know?" as the follow-up.

q.hi: Agar aapka manager aapke last saal ke kaam ko ek line mein summarize kare to kya bolega?
q.en: If your manager summarized your last year of work in one line, what would it say?

checks.hi: Self-awareness aur kya aapki self-image feedback se match karti hai.
checks.en: Self-awareness and whether your self-image matches real feedback.

hi: Ek clear theme (e.g. "payments reliability ka owner")
1-2 concrete achievements jo isko back karein
Performance review se actual feedback
Ek area jahan manager improvement chahta hai
en: One clear theme (e.g. "owner of payments reliability")
1-2 concrete achievements that back it
Real feedback from performance reviews
One area your manager wants you to grow in

tip.hi: Overclaim mat karo; reference check mein yahi poocha ja sakta hai.
tip.en: Do not overclaim; this is exactly what a reference check might verify.

q.hi: Apna resume walk through kariye aur current role par focus kariye.
q.en: Walk me through your resume, focusing on your current role.

checks.hi: Communication, career story ka flow, aur aage deep dive ke liye hooks.
checks.en: Communication, the arc of your career, and hooks for the deep dive.

hi: 2 minute ka crisp summary, chronological
Har role mein scope aur 1 highlight
Current team, product aur aapki responsibility
Aage kya dhoondh rahe ho, us par end karo
en: A crisp 2-minute summary in order
Scope and one highlight per role
Current team, product and your responsibility
End with what you are looking for next

tip.hi: Resume line by line mat padho; story batao aur ek strong project par hook chhodo.
tip.en: Do not read the resume aloud; tell a story and leave a hook to your best project.

q.hi: Apne current project ka high-level architecture whiteboard par samjhaiye.
q.en: Explain the high-level architecture of your current project on a whiteboard.

checks.hi: Kya aapko poora system samajh aata hai ya sirf apna component.
checks.en: Whether you understand the whole system or only your own component.

hi: Main components aur data flow (client, services, DB, queue, cache)
Scale numbers: QPS, data size, users
Aapka component kahan fit hota hai
Known bottlenecks ya failure points
en: Main components and data flow (client, services, DB, queue, cache)
Scale numbers: QPS, data size, users
Where your component fits
Known bottlenecks or failure points

tip.hi: Pehle box diagram, phir zoom in; scale numbers yaad karke jao.
tip.en: Start with boxes, then zoom in; memorize your real scale numbers.

q.hi: Is project mein aapka exact contribution kya tha, team ke kaam se alag?
q.en: What exactly was your contribution to this project, separate from the team?

checks.hi: Credit inflation pakadna aur aapki actual depth jaanchna.
checks.en: Catching credit inflation and probing your real depth.

hi: Kaun se modules/PRs aapne design aur likhe
Kaun se decisions aapne liye ya influence kiye
Kya dusron ne kiya, clearly batao
Ek tricky detail jo sirf author ko pata hoti hai
en: Which modules/PRs you designed and wrote
Which decisions you made or influenced
What others did, stated clearly
One tricky detail only the author would know

tip.hi: "Hum ne kiya" ke bajaye "maine X design kiya, Y ne Z kiya" bolo.
tip.en: Replace "we did" with "I designed X, while Y built Z".

q.hi: Is system ko 10x traffic ke liye scale karna ho to aap kya badloge?
q.en: If this system had to handle 10x traffic, what would you change?

checks.hi: Kya aap apne system ki limits jaante ho aur scaling sochte ho.
checks.en: Whether you know your system's limits and can reason about scaling.

hi: Pehle kya tootega (DB, single instance, hot partition)
Caching, sharding, async/queues, read replicas
Cost aur complexity trade-off
Load test ya capacity planning kaise karoge
en: What breaks first (DB, single instance, hot partition)
Caching, sharding, async/queues, read replicas
Cost and complexity trade-offs
How you would load test or capacity plan

tip.hi: Generic answers se bacho; apne system ka specific bottleneck naam lo.
tip.en: Avoid generic answers; name your system's specific bottleneck.

q.hi: Aapke project mein data model / database schema kaise design kiya gaya tha aur kyon?
q.en: How was the data model or database schema designed in your project, and why?

checks.hi: Data modelling ki samajh aur DB choice ka reasoning.
checks.en: Understanding of data modelling and reasoning behind the DB choice.

hi: Main entities aur relationships
SQL vs NoSQL choice aur reason
Indexes, partitioning, access patterns
Consistency aur transactions kaise handle hue
en: Main entities and relationships
SQL vs NoSQL choice and why
Indexes, partitioning and access patterns
How consistency and transactions were handled

tip.hi: Access patterns se shuru karo, schema unse nikalta hai.
tip.en: Start from access patterns; the schema follows from them.

q.hi: Aapka system production mein kaise monitor hota hai aur failure aane par kya hota hai?
q.en: How is your system monitored in production, and what happens when it fails?

checks.hi: Operational maturity: observability, alerting, on-call aur resilience.
checks.en: Operational maturity: observability, alerting, on-call and resilience.

hi: Metrics, logs, traces aur dashboards (Grafana, Datadog)
Alerts aur SLOs
Retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, fallbacks
Deploy/rollback strategy
en: Metrics, logs, traces and dashboards (Grafana, Datadog)
Alerts and SLOs
Retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, fallbacks
Deploy and rollback strategy

tip.hi: Ek real incident ka zikr karo jo monitoring ne pakda.
tip.en: Mention a real incident that monitoring caught.

q.hi: Agar aapko yeh project aaj scratch se dobara banana ho to aap kya alag karoge?
q.en: If you rebuilt this project from scratch today, what would you do differently?

checks.hi: Reflection, critical thinking aur growth mindset.
checks.en: Reflection, critical thinking and growth mindset.

hi: 1-2 concrete changes (architecture, tech, process)
Original decision us waqt kyon sahi laga
Ab kya naya pata hai (scale, requirements)
Change ka expected benefit
en: 1-2 concrete changes (architecture, tech, process)
Why the original choice made sense then
What you know now (scale, requirements)
Expected benefit of the change

tip.hi: "Kuch nahi badlunga" kabhi mat bolo; purane context ki respect bhi rakho.
tip.en: Never say "nothing"; but respect the context the original choice was made in.

q.hi: Ek technical decision bataiye jisme aapne do approaches ke beech trade-off kiya.
q.en: Tell me about a technical decision where you weighed trade-offs between two approaches.

checks.hi: Structured decision making aur alternatives sochne ki aadat.
checks.en: Structured decision making and the habit of considering alternatives.

hi: Options kya the
Criteria: latency, cost, complexity, time-to-market, team skill
Kaise evaluate kiya (POC, benchmark, design doc)
Final choice aur uska outcome
en: What the options were
Criteria: latency, cost, complexity, time-to-market, team skill
How you evaluated (POC, benchmark, design doc)
Final choice and its outcome

tip.hi: Har option ke pros aur cons dono bolo; ek-tarfa answer shaky lagta hai.
tip.en: State pros and cons of every option; one-sided answers sound shallow.

q.hi: Aisa koi design decision jo aapko baad mein galat laga ya jiska aapko regret hai?
q.en: Describe a design decision you later regretted.

checks.hi: Honesty, ownership aur galti se seekhne ki ability.
checks.en: Honesty, ownership and the ability to learn from mistakes.

hi: Decision aur us waqt ka reasoning
Kab aur kaise pata chala ki galat tha
Kaise fix ya migrate kiya
Ab decisions mein kya alag karte ho
en: The decision and the reasoning at the time
When and how you found out it was wrong
How you fixed or migrated
What you now do differently

tip.hi: Real galti chuno, fake weakness nahi; zyada time learning par do.
tip.en: Pick a real mistake, not a humblebrag; spend most time on the learning.

q.hi: Aapne apne project mein yeh specific technology (DB, queue, framework) kyon choose ki?
q.en: Why did you choose this specific technology (DB, queue, framework) for your project?

checks.hi: Kya choice soch samajh kar thi ya default/hype se.
checks.en: Whether the choice was deliberate or just default or hype.

hi: Requirement jisne choice drive ki
Alternatives jo consider kiye (e.g. Kafka vs RabbitMQ vs SQS)
Iski known limitations
Kya yeh choice sahi saabit hui
en: The requirement that drove the choice
Alternatives considered (e.g. Kafka vs RabbitMQ vs SQS)
Its known limitations
Whether the choice held up

tip.hi: Agar choice aapki nahi thi to seedha bolo, phir apni raay do.
tip.en: If it was not your choice, say so, then give your own view.

q.hi: Kabhi aapne speed aur quality ke beech trade-off kiya, jaise tech debt lena?
q.en: Tell me about a time you traded quality for speed, such as taking on tech debt.

checks.hi: Pragmatism aur tech debt ko consciously manage karna.
checks.en: Pragmatism and managing tech debt consciously.

hi: Deadline ya business pressure kya tha
Kaun sa shortcut liya aur risk kya tha
Debt ko track kaise kiya (ticket, TODO, doc)
Baad mein pay down kiya ya nahi
en: What the deadline or business pressure was
Which shortcut you took and its risk
How you tracked the debt (ticket, doc)
Whether and how you paid it down

tip.hi: Dikhao ki debt intentional tha aur plan ke saath tha, laaparwahi nahi.
tip.en: Show the debt was intentional and planned, not careless.

q.hi: Jab requirements unclear ya ambiguous thi tab aapne kaise decision liya?
q.en: How did you make a decision when requirements were unclear or ambiguous?

checks.hi: Ambiguity handle karna aur bina perfect info ke aage badhna.
checks.en: Handling ambiguity and moving forward without perfect information.

hi: Kya unknown tha
Clarity ke liye kisse aur kya poocha
Assumptions likhe aur reversible decision liya
Iterate kaise kiya aur result
en: What was unknown
Whom you asked and what for clarity
Wrote down assumptions and chose a reversible path
How you iterated and the result

tip.hi: Assumptions document karna aur feedback loop chhota rakhna highlight karo.
tip.en: Highlight documenting assumptions and keeping feedback loops short.

q.hi: Aapne kabhi senior ya architect ke technical decision se disagree kiya? Kya hua?
q.en: Have you disagreed with a senior engineer's or architect's technical decision? What happened?

checks.hi: Backbone with respect: data se argue karna aur "disagree and commit".
checks.en: Backbone with respect: arguing with data and disagree-and-commit.

hi: Disagreement kis baat par tha
Data/POC se kaise point rakha
Final outcome, chahe aap jeete ya nahi
Decision ke baad kaise commit kiya
en: What the disagreement was about
How you made your case with data or a POC
Final outcome, whether or not you won
How you committed after the decision

tip.hi: Person nahi, idea par focus; ego wali kahani avoid karo.
tip.en: Focus on the idea, not the person; avoid ego-driven stories.

q.hi: Aapka sabse mushkil bug kaun sa tha aur aapne use kaise debug kiya?
q.en: What is the hardest bug you have debugged, and how did you find it?

checks.hi: Debugging approach, persistence aur technical depth.
checks.en: Debugging approach, persistence and technical depth.

hi: Symptom aur kyon mushkil tha (intermittent, prod-only)
Hypotheses aur unhe kaise eliminate kiya
Tools: logs, profiler, heap dump, tcpdump
Root cause, fix aur repeat rokne ka tareeka
en: The symptom and why it was hard (intermittent, prod-only)
Hypotheses and how you eliminated them
Tools: logs, profiler, heap dump, tcpdump
Root cause, fix and how you prevented recurrence

tip.hi: Kahani ko detective story ki tarah batao; root cause technically specific ho.
tip.en: Tell it like a detective story; make the root cause technically specific.

q.hi: Koi production incident bataiye jisme aap involved the; aapne kya kiya?
q.en: Tell me about a production incident you were involved in and what you did.

checks.hi: Pressure mein calm rehna, mitigation vs root cause ki samajh.
checks.en: Staying calm under pressure and knowing mitigation from root cause.

hi: Impact: kitne users, kitna time, kitna revenue
Pehle mitigate kiya (rollback, feature flag, scale up)
Communication stakeholders ke saath
RCA aur action items jo implement hue
en: Impact: users affected, duration, revenue
Mitigation first (rollback, feature flag, scale up)
Communication with stakeholders
RCA and the action items that shipped

tip.hi: Blameless tone rakho aur postmortem ke concrete action items batao.
tip.en: Keep a blameless tone and name concrete postmortem action items.

q.hi: Apni koi badi galti ya failure bataiye aur usse kya seekha.
q.en: Tell me about a significant mistake or failure of yours and what you learned.

checks.hi: Accountability aur self-reflection.
checks.en: Accountability and self-reflection.

hi: Galti kya thi, bina excuse ke
Impact kya hua
Turant kaise sambhala
Process ya habit mein permanent change
en: What the mistake was, without excuses
What the impact was
How you handled it right away
The lasting change to your process or habits

tip.hi: Blame shift mat karo; "maine" se shuru karo aur learning par khatam.
tip.en: Do not shift blame; start with "I" and end with the learning.

q.hi: Aisa project jo fail hua, cancel hua ya deadline miss hua; kya hua tha?
q.en: Tell me about a project that failed, got cancelled or missed its deadline.

checks.hi: Risk ko jaldi pehchanna aur bure outcome ko handle karna.
checks.en: Spotting risk early and handling a bad outcome.

hi: Project ka goal aur kya galat gaya
Warning signs kab dikhe
Aapne kya kiya: escalate, re-scope, communicate
Agli baar ke liye learning
en: The goal and what went wrong
When the warning signs appeared
What you did: escalate, re-scope, communicate
Learning for next time

tip.hi: Early escalation aur re-scoping dikhana maturity ka sign hai.
tip.en: Showing early escalation and re-scoping signals maturity.

q.hi: Aapke kariyar ka sabse bada technical challenge kya tha aur aapne use kaise overcome kiya?
q.en: What was the biggest technical challenge of your career and how did you overcome it?

checks.hi: Complexity handle karne ki capacity aur problem-solving approach.
checks.en: Capacity to handle complexity and your problem-solving approach.

hi: Challenge kyon mushkil tha (scale, legacy, constraints)
Problem ko kaise tod kar solve kiya
Kisse help li aur kya research kiya
Final result aur metrics
en: Why it was hard (scale, legacy, constraints)
How you broke the problem down
Who you asked and what you researched
Final result and metrics

tip.hi: STAR use karo; "Action" part sabse lamba hona chahiye.
tip.en: Use STAR; the Action part should be the longest.

q.hi: Tight deadline mein aapne kaam kaise deliver kiya, aur kya cut kiya?
q.en: How did you deliver under a tight deadline, and what did you cut?

checks.hi: Prioritization aur scope negotiation.
checks.en: Prioritization and scope negotiation.

hi: Deadline aur scope ka gap
Must-have vs nice-to-have kaise decide kiya
Stakeholders se scope negotiate kiya
Quality kaise bachayi aur result
en: The gap between deadline and scope
How you split must-have from nice-to-have
How you negotiated scope with stakeholders
How you protected quality, and the result

tip.hi: Heroic overtime nahi, smart prioritization dikhao.
tip.en: Show smart prioritization, not heroic overtime.

q.hi: Aisa project bataiye jo aapne end-to-end own kiya, design se production tak.
q.en: Tell me about a project you owned end-to-end, from design to production.

checks.hi: Ownership level: sirf code ya poora lifecycle.
checks.en: Level of ownership: just code, or the full lifecycle.

hi: Requirements aur design doc
Implementation, testing, rollout plan
Launch ke baad monitoring aur iteration
Cross-team dependencies kaise manage ki
en: Requirements and design doc
Implementation, testing, rollout plan
Post-launch monitoring and iteration
How you managed cross-team dependencies

tip.hi: Launch ke baad ka kaam bhi batao; wahin real ownership dikhti hai.
tip.en: Cover what happened after launch; that is where real ownership shows.

q.hi: Aapne kabhi kisi junior ya naye team member ko mentor kiya? Kaise?
q.en: Have you mentored a junior or new team member? How?

checks.hi: Leadership aur force multiplier banne ki ability (SDE-2/3 ke liye key).
checks.en: Leadership and being a force multiplier (key for SDE-2/3).

hi: Unki starting state aur goal
Kya kiya: pairing, code reviews, docs, stretch tasks
Unki growth ka measurable sign
Aapne mentoring se kya seekha
en: Their starting point and goal
What you did: pairing, code reviews, docs, stretch tasks
A measurable sign of their growth
What you learned from mentoring

tip.hi: Unki success ki baat karo, apni nahi.
tip.en: Talk about their success, not yours.

q.hi: Aisi situation jab aapne apne scope se bahar jaakar koi problem fix ki.
q.en: Describe a time you went beyond your scope to fix a problem.

checks.hi: Ownership mindset: "not my job" attitude to nahi.
checks.en: Ownership mindset versus a "not my job" attitude.

hi: Problem kis team/area ki thi
Aapne kyon step in kiya
Owner team ke saath kaise coordinate kiya
Outcome aur long-term fix
en: Which team or area owned the problem
Why you stepped in
How you coordinated with the owning team
Outcome and long-term fix

tip.hi: Dikhao ki aapne owners ko bypass nahi kiya, saath liya.
tip.en: Show you brought the owners along rather than bypassing them.

q.hi: Aapne kabhi cross-team project lead kiya ya multiple teams ko align kiya?
q.en: Have you led a cross-team project or aligned multiple teams?

checks.hi: Influence without authority aur communication skills.
checks.en: Influence without authority and communication skills.

hi: Kaun si teams aur unke conflicting goals
Alignment kaise banaya (RFC, sync, shared doc)
Blockers aur dependencies kaise track kiye
Result aur learning
en: Which teams and their conflicting goals
How you built alignment (RFC, syncs, shared doc)
How you tracked blockers and dependencies
Result and learning

tip.hi: SDE-3 ke liye yeh must-have story hai; ready rakho.
tip.en: For SDE-3 this story is a must-have; keep one ready.

q.hi: Aapne team ke engineering process ya code quality ko kaise improve kiya?
q.en: How have you improved your team's engineering process or code quality?

checks.hi: Team-level impact aur standards raise karna.
checks.en: Team-level impact and raising the bar.

hi: Kya problem thi (flaky tests, slow CI, bugs)
Kya introduce kiya (linting, review checklist, CI, testing)
Team ko adopt kaise karwaya
Measurable improvement
en: The problem (flaky tests, slow CI, bugs)
What you introduced (linting, review checklist, CI, tests)
How you drove adoption
Measurable improvement

tip.hi: Adoption ki kahani bhi batao; tool banana easy hai, team se use karwana mushkil.
tip.en: Tell the adoption story; building a tool is easy, getting it used is hard.

q.hi: Kabhi kisi teammate ke saath conflict hua? Aapne use kaise resolve kiya?
q.en: Tell me about a conflict with a teammate and how you resolved it.

checks.hi: Emotional maturity aur collaboration.
checks.en: Emotional maturity and collaboration.

hi: Conflict kis baat par tha (technical, priorities)
Unka perspective samajhne ki koshish
Common ground aur resolution
Relationship baad mein kaisa raha
en: What it was about (technical, priorities)
How you sought their perspective
Common ground and resolution
How the relationship was afterwards

tip.hi: Doosre ko villain mat banao; dono taraf fair raho.
tip.en: Do not make the other person the villain; stay fair to both sides.

q.hi: Aapne product manager ya non-tech stakeholder ke saath disagreement kaise handle kiya?
q.en: How did you handle a disagreement with a product manager or non-technical stakeholder?

checks.hi: Business context samajhna aur tech ko simple bhasha mein samjhana.
checks.en: Understanding business context and explaining tech in plain terms.

hi: Unki requirement aur aapki concern
Trade-off ko business terms mein samjhaya
Alternatives offer kiye (phased rollout, MVP)
Final decision aur outcome
en: Their ask and your concern
How you framed the trade-off in business terms
Alternatives offered (phased rollout, MVP)
Final decision and outcome

tip.hi: "No" ke bajaye "haan, agar..." wala approach dikhao.
tip.en: Show a "yes, if..." approach rather than a flat "no".

q.hi: Code review mein tough feedback diya ya liya ho, aisa example bataiye.
q.en: Give an example of giving or receiving tough feedback in a code review.

checks.hi: Feedback culture aur ego-free collaboration.
checks.en: Feedback culture and ego-free collaboration.

hi: Feedback kya tha
Kaise deliver kiya ya receive kiya
Kya change hua code ya behaviour mein
Iska long-term asar
en: What the feedback was
How you delivered or received it
What changed in the code or behaviour
The longer-term effect

tip.hi: Specific aur kind dono raho; defensive reaction ki kahani mat batao.
tip.en: Be specific and kind; avoid stories where you got defensive.

q.hi: Aisa teammate jo underperform kar raha tha ya cooperate nahi kar raha tha, use kaise handle kiya?
q.en: How did you handle a teammate who was underperforming or not cooperating?

checks.hi: Empathy, directness aur kab escalate karna hai.
checks.en: Empathy, directness and knowing when to escalate.

hi: Issue ka impact team par
Private conversation aur root cause samajhna
Help offer ki ya expectations clear kiye
Zaroorat padne par manager ko involve kiya
en: The impact on the team
A private conversation to understand the cause
Offered help or set clear expectations
Involved the manager when needed

tip.hi: Pehle empathy, phir escalation; gossip ya blame ka tone nahi.
tip.en: Empathy first, escalation second; no gossip or blame.

q.hi: Aapki team mein aapka role kya hota hai aur log aapke paas kis cheez ke liye aate hain?
q.en: What role do you play on your team, and what do people come to you for?

checks.hi: Team mein aapki reputation aur strengths.
checks.en: Your reputation and strengths on the team.

hi: Domain ya skill jisme aap go-to ho
Ek example jab kisi ko unblock kiya
Team dynamics mein aapka contribution
Kaise yeh role build hua
en: The domain or skill you are the go-to for
An example of unblocking someone
Your contribution to team dynamics
How you grew into that role

tip.hi: Strength ko real example se prove karo, sirf adjective nahi.
tip.en: Prove the strength with an example, not just adjectives.

q.hi: Aapne kabhi koi nayi technology bahut jaldi seekh kar use kiya? Kaise?
q.en: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly and apply it.

checks.hi: Learning agility aur self-learning ka tareeka.
checks.en: Learning agility and how you teach yourself.

hi: Kya seekhna tha aur deadline
Learning approach: docs, POC, experts, source code
Kaise production mein apply kiya
Mistakes aur result
en: What you had to learn and the deadline
Approach: docs, POC, experts, source code
How you applied it in production
Mistakes and result

tip.hi: Concrete learning plan dikhao, sirf "YouTube dekha" nahi.
tip.en: Show a concrete learning plan, not just "watched tutorials".

q.hi: Aapko mila sabse critical feedback kya tha aur aapne uspe kya kiya?
q.en: What is the most critical feedback you have received, and what did you do about it?

checks.hi: Coachability aur self-improvement.
checks.en: Coachability and self-improvement.

hi: Feedback kya tha aur kisne diya
Pehla reaction honestly
Kya action liye
Ab kaise change dikhta hai
en: What the feedback was and who gave it
Your honest first reaction
The actions you took
How the change shows today

tip.hi: Real feedback chuno jo thoda chubhta ho; "main bahut kaam karta hoon" nahi.
tip.en: Pick feedback that actually stung; not "I work too hard".

q.hi: Aapki technical strengths aur weaknesses kya hain?
q.en: What are your technical strengths and weaknesses?

checks.hi: Self-awareness aur role-fit.
checks.en: Self-awareness and fit for the role.

hi: 1-2 strengths with evidence
1 real weakness jo job-critical nahi
Weakness par kya kaam kar rahe ho
Role ke saath kaise match hota hai
en: 1-2 strengths with evidence
One real weakness that is not job-critical
What you are doing about the weakness
How it fits the role

tip.hi: Weakness ke saath improvement plan zaroor do.
tip.en: Always pair the weakness with an improvement plan.

q.hi: Last 6 mahine mein aapne kya naya seekha, kaam ke andar ya bahar?
q.en: What have you learned recently, at work or outside it, in the last six months?

checks.hi: Curiosity aur kya aap current rehte ho.
checks.en: Curiosity and whether you stay current.

hi: Topic aur kyon chuna
Kaise seekha (course, book, side project, open source)
Kahan apply kiya
Aage kya seekhna hai
en: The topic and why you chose it
How you learned it (course, book, side project, open source)
Where you applied it
What you want to learn next

tip.hi: Interviewer usi topic par deep question pooch sakta hai; ready raho.
tip.en: Expect a deep follow-up on that topic; be ready for it.

q.hi: Apne pichle project mein aap ek cheez improve kar sakte to kya karte?
q.en: If you could improve one thing in a past project, what would it be?

checks.hi: Critical thinking aur ownership of quality.
checks.en: Critical thinking and ownership of quality.

hi: Specific gap (testing, observability, design, process)
Uska kya cost tha
Aap kaise fix karte
Ab naye projects mein yeh kaise apply karte ho
en: A specific gap (testing, observability, design, process)
What it cost
How you would fix it
How you apply this in new projects

tip.hi: Doosron ki galti nahi, system ya apni gap batao.
tip.en: Name a gap in the system or in your own work, not someone else's mistake.

q.hi: Aap apni current company kyon chhodna chahte ho?
q.en: Why do you want to leave your current company?

checks.hi: Motivation, red flags, aur kya aap jaldi phir chhod doge.
checks.en: Motivation, red flags, and flight risk.

hi: Positive framing: growth, scale, domain
Current company mein kya seekha
Naye role mein kya chahiye
Koi badmouthing nahi
en: Positive framing: growth, scale, domain
What you gained at the current company
What you want from the next role
No badmouthing

tip.hi: "Run away from" nahi, "run towards" wali story batao.
tip.en: Tell a "running towards" story, not "running away from".

q.hi: Aap is company aur is role mein kyon interested ho?
q.en: Why are you interested in this company and this role?

checks.hi: Research kiya hai ya nahi aur genuine interest.
checks.en: Whether you did your research and are genuinely interested.

hi: Company ka product/engineering challenge jo pasand hai
Aapke experience ka role se match
Engineering blog ya tech stack ka reference
Aap kya contribute kar sakte ho
en: The product or engineering challenge that excites you
How your experience maps to the role
A reference to their engineering blog or stack
What you can contribute

tip.hi: Company ka engineering blog padh kar jao; generic praise se bacho.
tip.en: Read their engineering blog beforehand; avoid generic praise.

q.hi: Aap 3-5 saal baad khud ko kahan dekhte ho?
q.en: Where do you see yourself in 3 to 5 years?

checks.hi: Ambition aur role ke saath alignment.
checks.en: Ambition and alignment with the role.

hi: IC track vs management preference
Technical depth ya domain jahan grow karna hai
Yeh role us path mein kaise fit hota hai
Realistic aur flexible tone
en: IC versus management preference
The technical depth or domain you want to grow in
How this role fits that path
A realistic, flexible tone

tip.hi: Ambitious par realistic raho; role se mismatch wala goal mat bolo.
tip.en: Be ambitious but realistic; do not name a goal the role cannot offer.

q.hi: Aapne apne career mein job ya domain kyon switch kiya? Resume ke gaps samjhaiye.
q.en: Why did you switch jobs or domains, and can you explain any gaps on your resume?

checks.hi: Career decisions ka logic aur stability.
checks.en: The logic behind career moves and stability.

hi: Har switch ka ek clear reason
Har move se kya mila
Gap ho to honest explanation aur us time kya kiya
Overall story jo current goal tak le aaye
en: A clear reason for each move
What each move gave you
An honest explanation of any gap and what you did then
A through-line leading to your current goal

tip.hi: Short aur confident raho; over-explain mat karo.
tip.en: Keep it short and confident; do not over-explain.

q.hi: Aapka ideal team ya work environment kaisa hota hai?
q.en: What does your ideal team or work environment look like?

checks.hi: Culture fit aur kya aap is team mein khush rahoge.
checks.en: Culture fit and whether you would thrive on this team.

hi: Ownership, autonomy, feedback culture jaise values
Kis tarah ke kaam se energy milti hai
Pichle team ka example jo kaam kiya
Company ke culture se match
en: Values like ownership, autonomy and feedback culture
The kind of work that energizes you
An example from a past team that worked
How it matches the company's culture

tip.hi: Honest raho par company ki known culture ke against mat bolo.
tip.en: Be honest, but do not contradict the company's known culture.

q.hi: Kya aapke paas humare liye koi sawaal hain?
q.en: Do you have any questions for us?

checks.hi: Curiosity, seriousness aur aap kis cheez ko value karte ho.
checks.en: Curiosity, seriousness and what you value.

hi: Team ke current challenges aur roadmap
Success pehle 6 mahine mein kaisi dikhti hai
On-call, release aur code review culture
Interviewer ka khud ka experience
en: The team's current challenges and roadmap
What success looks like in the first six months
On-call, release and code review culture
The interviewer's own experience there

tip.hi: 2-3 thoughtful sawaal ready rakho; "nahi, sab clear hai" kabhi mat bolo.
tip.en: Have 2-3 thoughtful questions ready; never say "no, all clear".
